ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১) At the rate of 8.5% p. a. simple interest, sum of Tk. 4800 will earn how much interest in 2 years 6 months?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Principal = Tk. 4800
Rate = 8.5%
Time = 2 years + 6 months
         = 2 + (6/12)
         = 2 + (1/2)
         = 5/2
         = 2.5 years


Simple Interest = (4800 × 8.5 × 2.5)/100
                         = Tk.1020

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২) The compound interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 10% per annum is Tk. 525 . The simple interest on the same sum for doubled the time at half the rate percent per annum is-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the sum be Tk. P

Here 
  P(1 + 10/100)2 - P = 525
or, P(110/100)2 - P = 525 
or, P(1.1)2 - P = 525
or, P( 1.21 - 1) = 525
or, P × 0.21 = 525 
or, p = 525/.21
   P = 2500

Again
S.I = (2500 × 5 × 4)/100
    = 500

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩) A sum of money at a simple interest doubles in 5 years. It will become four times in:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Case I:
Let principal be x
So, Amount after 5 years = 2x
Simple interest = Amount - Principal
                         = 2x - x
                         = x
Interest = Principal
So x = (x × R × 5)/100
⇒ R = 100/5 

Case II:
Amount = 4x
Interest = 4x - x = 3x
Interest = 3 × Principal
Now
3x = [x × (100/5) × T2]/100
T2/5 = 3
⇒ T2 = 15 years

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪) The principal that amounts to Tk. 4913 in 3 years at (25/4)% per annum compound interest compounded annually, is-
৫) At what rate percent of simple interest will a sum of money double itself in 15 years ?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the principal be x.
Then, the amount after 15 years be 2x.
Let the rate of interest be R.
S.I. = 2x - x = x

Then,
S.I. = P × R × T/100
⇒ x = x × R × 15/100
⇒ R = 100/15
      = 20/3 
∴ The rate of interest is 20/3%.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৬) What will be the difference between S.I and C.I on a sum of Tk. 1600 for 2 years at the same rate of interest of 25/2% per annum?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Interest rate r = (25/2)% = 1/8

S.I. = (1600 × 2 × 1)/8 = Tk.400

C.I. = [1600 × (1 + 1/8)2 - 1600] 
      = [1600  × (9/8) × (9/8) -1600
      = 2025 - 1600
      = Tk. 425

Difference = (425 - 400) = Tk. 25.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৭) The simple interest on a certain sum of money at the rate of 5 p.a. for 8 years is Tk. 840. The rate of interest for which the same amount of interest can be received on the same sum after 5 years is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
S.I =Tk. 840
R = 5%
T = 8 years
Principal = (100 × 840)/(5 × 8)
              = Tk. 2100

Again 
S.I =Tk. 840
Principal = Tk. 2100
T = 5 years
Rate = (100 × 840)/(2100 × 5)
        = 8%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৮) How many shares of market value Tk. 25 each can be purchased for Tk.15300, brokerage being 2% ?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
CP of each share = Tk. (25 + 2% of 25) = Tk. 25.50. 

Number of shares= 15300/25.50
                             = 600

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৯) Simple interest on a certain sum at a certain annual rate of interest is 1/9 of the sum. If the numbers representing rate percent and time in years be equal, then the rate of interest is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let sum=x Then, S.I.=x/9.
Let rate=R% and time= R years.
Now
(x × R × R)/100 = x/9
R2/100 = 1/9
R2 = 100/9
R = 10/3

Rate=(10/3)%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১০) A man invested Tk. 5280 in Tk.10 shares quoted at Tk. 8.25. If the rate of dividend be 12%, his annual income is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Number of shares =(5280/8.25​) = 640

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১১) The Simple Interest on a sum of money will be Tk. 700 after 10 years. If the principal is increased three times after 5 years, what will be the total interest at the end of 10 years?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let 
The sum be Tk. x 
S.I = Tk. 700  
Time = 10 years  

Rate = (100 × 700)/(x × 10)% = (7000/x)%

S. I for first 5 years = Tk. ( x × 5 × 7000)/(x × 100)
                               = Tk. 350 

S. I for first 5 years = Tk. ( 3x × 5 × 7000)/(x × 100)
                               = Tk. 1050

Total interest = Tk. (350 + 1050) = Tk. 1400

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১২) A 10% stock yields 8%. The market value of the stock is-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
For an income of Tk. 8, investment = Tk. 100.
For an income of Tk. 10, investment = Tk. (100/8) × 10
                                                         = Tk. 125

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৩) A certain sum of money is invested at an interest rate of 5% per annum and a second sum twice as large as the first is invested at 5.5% p. a. The total amount of interest earned from two investments together is Tk. 1000 per year and the interest is withdrawn every year. The second sum invested is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let 
Two sums Tk. x and Tk. 2x

Now
{(x × 5 × 1)/100} + {(2x × 5.5× 1)/100} = 1000
5x + 11x = 100000
16x = 100000
x = 6250

Second sum =Tk. (6250 × 2) =  Tk. 12500

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৪) A man invested Tk.1552 in a stock at 97 to obtain an income of Tk. 128. The dividend from of the stock is-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
By investing Tk. 1552, income Tk. 128
By investing Tk. 97, income = (128 ​×97)/1552
                                             = 8

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৫) A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Tk. 815 in 3 years and to Tk. 854 in 4 years. The sum is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
S. I for 1 year = Tk. (854 - 815)
                       = Tk. 39 
S. I for 3 years = Tk. (39 × 3) 
                        =  Tk. 117

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৬) By investing Tk. 3450 in a 4.5% stock , a man obtains an income of Tk. 150. Find the market price of the stock.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
To earn Tk. 150 investment = Tk. 3450
To earn Tk. 4.5 investment = Tk. (3450 × 4.5)/150
                                            = Tk. 103.5

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৭) How much time will it take for an amount of tk. 450 to yield Tk. 81 as interest at 4.5% per annum of simple interest?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Here 
Principal = Tk. 450
S.I = Tk. 81 
R = 4.5% 

Time = (100 × 81)/(450 × 4.5)
         = 4 years

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৯) The compound interest on Tk. 2500 for 2 years at 10% p. a is-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Given,
Principal, P = Tk. 2500
Compound rate , R = 10%
Time n = 2 years

 
Compound Principal = [2500(1 + 10/100)2]
                                  = [2500(1.1)2]
                                   =3025

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২০) The interest on a certain deposit at 4.5% p.a. is TK. 202.50 in one year. How much will the additional interest in one year be on the same deposit at 5% p.a. ?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
S.I = TK. 202.50 
r = 4.5% 
n = 1

Now
I = pnr/100
P = I × 100/nr = ( 202.50 × 100)/( 1× 4.5) = 4500 Tk.

Again 
I = pnr
  = 4500 × 1 × 5/100 = 225

The total additional interest = ( 225 - 202.50) Tk. = Tk. 22.50

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২১) The difference between simple and compound interests compounded annually on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 4% per annum is Tk. 1. The sum (in Tk.) is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the sum be Tk. x.
Then
C. I = x(1 + 4/100)2 - x
      = x(104/100)2 - x
      = x(26/25)2 - x
      = 676x/625 - x
      = (676x - 625x)/625
      = 51x/625

S.I =(x × 4 × 2)/100 = 2x/25

Now
(51x/625) - (2x/25) = 1
(51x - 50x)/625 = 1
x /625 = 1
x = 625

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২২) A man invested Tk. 14400 in Tk. 100 shares of a company at 20% premium. If the company declares 5% dividend at the end of the year, then how much does he get?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Number of shares = 14400/120 = 120 
Face value = Tk. (120 × 100) = Tk. 12000 
 
Annual income = (5/100) × 12000 = Tk . 600

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৩) There is 60% increase in an amount in 6 years at simple interest. What will be the compound interest of Tk.1400 after 3 years at the same rate?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let P = Tk. 100.
Then, S.I. Tk. = 60 and T = 6 years


Rate =(100 × 60)/(100 × 6) = 10%

Now, P = Tk.. 1400.
T = 3 years and R = 10% p.a.


C.I. =1400(1 + 10/100)3 - 1400
      = 1400(1.1)3 - 1400
      = 1863.4 - 1400
       = 463.4

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৪) What will be the ratio of simple interest earned by certain amount at the same rate of interest for 6 years and that for 9 years?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let 
The principal be P and  rate of interest be r% 

Required ratio = [(P × r × 6)/100]/[(P × r × 9)/100]
                          =6Pr/9Pr
                          = 6/9
                            = 2/3
                          = 2 : 3

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৫) Hannan invested an amount of Tk. 5000 in a fixed deposit scheme for 2 years at compound interest rate 5 p.c.p.a. How much amount will Hannan get on maturity of the fixed deposit?
২৬) How long (years) will it take a sum of money invested at 5% p.a. S. I. to increase its value by 40%?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let sum of money be Tk. x
S.I = 40% of x = 2x​/5

Given rate =5%

Time =[100×(2x​​/5)×(1​​/5x)​]
   = 8 years

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৭) The compound interest on Tk. 30000 at 7% per annum is Tk. 4347. The period (in years) is:
২৮) Tk. 9800 are invested partly in 9% stock at 75 and 10% stock at 80 to have equal amount of incomes. The investment in 9% stock is-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let 
The investment in 9% stock is = x
The investment in 10% stock is = 9800 - x

Now 
(9/75) × x = (10/80) × (9800 - x)
3x/25 = (9800 - x)/8
24x  = (9800 - x)25
24x + 25x = 245000
49x = 245000
x= 245000/49
x=5000

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৯) Two equal sum of money were lent at simple interest at 11% p. a for the 7/2 years and 9/2 years respectively. If the difference in interests for two periods was Tk. 411.4, Then each sum is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the each sum be x 
Now 
{(x × 11 × 9)/(100 × 2)} - {(x × 11 × 7)/(100 × 2)} = 411.4
(99x - 77x)/200 = 411.4
22x = 82,280
x= 82,280/22
x = 3740

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩০) In order to obtain an income of Tk. 650 from 8% stock at Tk.96. One must make an investment of-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
To obtain Tk.8, investment = Tk. 96.

To obtain Tk.650, investment = Tk. {96/8) × 650}
